change_summary: Added an audit/screen-only script that reruns the current accepted stack, computes day-3/day-5/day-10 in-position diagnostics, and estimates trade-level early-exit PnL for simple decay rules. No production strategy code was changed or promoted.

delta_metrics.decision_basis: Best positive approximations were tiny and sparse, while nearby rules cut large delayed winners. The signal is not strong enough to justify a real backtester early-exit implementation.

hypothesis: After accepted winner-truncation and position-cap improvements, the next distinct alpha mechanism may be capital release from positions whose early hold quality decays. If a position is still weak after 3/5/10 trading days, it may be lower-EV to keep occupying risk budget.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage; this deterministic lifecycle audit does not change LLM responsibilities.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull where only one weak-hold trigger helped slightly
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where weak early holds sometimes became major winners
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape where strict loss-only helped one loser but looser weakness rules cut winners

next_retry_requires: Do not retry generic day-5/day-10 weak-hold early exits by only nudging unrealized-PnL or RS thresholds
Hold-quality lifecycle work needs a stronger adverse-information source such as fresh negative news, earnings deterioration, sector breakdown, or repeated failed reclaim
If promoted later, implement through the real backtester because trade-level approximation does not model freed-slot reinvestment
notes: This was alpha_search, not measurement repair. It deliberately pivoted away from the rejected target-width/post-target branch and changed no production strategy code.

parameters.parity_warning: trade-level approximation only; does not replay freed-slot reinvestment or equity-curve Sharpe

rejection_reason: Rejected on mechanism quality before production patch. Simple day-5/day-10 hold decay based on unrealized PnL and RS is unstable and risks truncating delayed trend winners.
